mechanism.claim: When large aggressive-flow bars move BTC disproportionately more than small aggressive-flow bars within a completed volatile auction, marginal liquidity is convex rather than linear. If aggregate aggressive flow and block return agree, follow that informed-flow direction for eight hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of aggregate signed aggressive quote flow and completed block return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVTIER compares first-half and second-half aggregate return per turnover. HVPIAR compares upside and downside return per turnover. Kyle handoff compares venues. HVFIC instead conditions one-venue through-origin flow-response slopes on within-block flow magnitude and measures nonlinear marginal-impact convexity; no time half, return-sign bucket, spot source, funding, OI, or fitted outcome is used.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35 percent
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: offset 01/09/17 UTC nonlinear impact-convexity onsets are absent from Gross9

features.block: 480 exact coherent native BTCUSDT perpetual one-minute rows [D-8h,D), aggregated into 96 exact five-minute bars
features.magnitude_split: strict within-block median of abs(bar_flow); exactly median ties are excluded; require at least 32 high and 32 low bars
features.conditional_beta: sum(flow*return)/sum(flow^2) separately for high- and low-magnitude bars; both finite strictly positive
features.convexity_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 source-valid positive convexities, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.block_return: log(last close/first open), strict nonzero and same sign as aggregate_flow
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared five-minute bar returns), strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 source-valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.onset: full eligible state true now and false at immediately prior source-valid decision

clock.reservation: natural half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

definitions.no_convexity_tail: positive convexity plus variation and agreement without rank
definitions.one_block_stale_convexity: prior convexity with current flow direction and variation

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no source, aggregation, magnitude split, beta, rank, variation, agreement, onset, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
